# Neo Film School

> > India's first integrated film school in Kochi, Kerala, offering professional diplomas in film direction, cinematography, production management, screen acting, and VFX, led by industry veterans from FTII and IIM.

Neo Film School (NEOS) is a comprehensive filmmaking institution founded by Dr. Jain Joseph, combining practical training with industry connections through Neo Film Republic (NFR). The school has produced successful alumni working across Indian cinema, including cinematographers, sound designers, and actors, while hosting regular industry sessions with professionals like Sibi Malayil and Mammootty.

## Key Topics

- Film Direction
- Cinematography
- Film Production Management
- Screen Acting

## Diploma Programs

- [Film Direction](https://www.neofilmschool.com/courses/film-direction): Professional diploma in film direction by Siby Jose Challishery
- [Film Production Management](https://www.neofilmschool.com/courses/film-production-management): Four-month diploma in film production management by Jain Joseph
- [Screen Acting](https://www.neofilmschool.com/courses/screen-acting): Screen acting diploma with performance training for film actors
- [Crafting Cinematic Magic: Neo's Diploma in Cinematography Revealed](https://www.neofilmschool.com/crafting-cinematic-magic-neos-diploma-in-cinematography-revealed): Overview of Neo's cinematography diploma program and techniques
